Question: Re: Islamic Names Salam : I have put my sons name as AHMED MAZEEN, is it a good name? can you please give me the propper meaning to this name and is mazeen & mazin gives the similer meaning? and which one is the best out of those two plz? Answer ID: 8622 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2301/1891=B/1429) Mazeen ( مزین ) means: beautiful, decorated. Mazin ( مازن ) means: egg of ant. The first name is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
